description.value: The Gorge Waterway Nature House is a Capital Regional District (CRD)-operated interpretive facility situated along Victoria's Gorge Waterway, a popular recreational corridor for cyclists and paddlers. It serves as a free community education centre focused on the ecology and natural history of the Gorge Waterway watershed. The location puts it directly on route for cyclists exploring the trail network around the waterway.
